Links

Package Maintenance

bspam R package is maintained at:
https://github.com/kamataak/bspam

Shiny App

bspam is also available as a Shiny App with limited features at:
https://shinyviz.smu.edu/shiny/public/bspam-main/

Related Publications

MCEM Algorithm for Calibration

  • Potgieter, C. J., Kamata, A., Kara, Y., & Qiao, X. (2025). Joint analysis of dispersed count-time data using a bivariate latent factor model. British Journal of Mathematical and Statistical Psychology, 79, 207-228. https://doi.org/10.1111/bmsp.70005

Calibration and Scoring by Bayesian Approach

  • Kara, Y., Kamata, A., Potgieter, C., & Nese, J. F. A. (2020). Estimating model-based oral reading fluency: Bayesian approach. Educational and Psychological Measurement, 80, 847-869. https://doi.org/10.1177/0013164419900208

Scoring by MLE, MAP, and EAP

  • Potgieter, C., Qiao, X., Kamata, A., & Kara, Y. (2024). Likelihood-based estimation of model-derived oral reading fluency. Journal of Educational Measurement. http://dx.doi.org/10.1111/jedm.12404
